review: CurrentRitualPanel still validates the source once at its existing entry. Shared reference routing adds event, exact exchange target and existing fixed-stage navigation while retaining independent workspace dialogs. Retained page context binds ritual source identity, scene, choice and acquisition relation; existing host guards handle changed source/selection and reuse matching ancestors. Exchange reward and recipe are separate original records: direct reward landing retains the source choice, and an explicit header action reads the recipe from the current validated exchange packet. No guessed parent link or quantity is added. Presentation-only SHORT_LINES moves repeated qualification into existing details; original effect/amount fields remain unchanged. Count labels derive from the actual catalogue. Adopted FlowLayout wraps controls; ignored tab height prevents hidden pages forcing a586px body. No new try/catch, per-operation persistence, or dependency.
